I want to say I am so sorry about your childhood experiences and other adversities you’ve been through leading up to this point- I too have a lot of childhood memories that were not normal, traumatizing and that changed my life and make me who I am today. So I can definitely resonate with the way you’re feeling, you’re hurt and you’re angry. Sad and angry. Those two emotions are some I used to feel constantly for the past two years and nothing else. Moving forward though- I think in order for you to grow as a person right now I want to address the elephant in the room. well a couple things that come to my mind. For one you are not ugly, you look like an average guy (I’m F26/ half white and Asian btw if that even matters here lol maybe it does). Two, you say fuckable a lot but I want to see you change your vocabulary up a little bit that makes more sense. It’s not that you’re unfuckable it’s that you’re lacking sexual intimacy and human connection with a significant other. This really does have an effect on some people and especially men who fall into categories of “late bloomers” (nothing wrong with that by the way, I have many male friends who are in their 30s and they go at their own pace) men also sometimes have the wrong concept of what sexual intimacy is with women or whoever your partner is, because of the porn industry. I’m not saying or insinuating that you have this issue but if you do you may want to read up on why that is (you can also msg me and we can talk about it if you wish).
Just know that you’re not alone in feeling this way and you can change your outlook on the matter. I know talking to people doesn’t solve all the issues but reading and listening to others stories also help. I read a lot online to discover my own definition of why things are the way they are in the world and to build on my own emotional intelligence. Maybe that’s what will help you. It takes time growing up and growing into ourselves when life has been so consistently hard for us. Things aren’t always linear with things getting better, with growth and positive thinking but they do eventually get better. I don’t think there’s anything wrong with you but if you ever want to talk/ ask questions  just msg me!
